prompt: Write me a cold email to the head of sponsorship at a large exchange, inviting them to sponsor our summit in November. Use PIBER.
expected_behavior: Transposed mode at L2 on the compression ladder. The five nodes run underneath a 90-word email with no visible labels. Status is peer-level throughout.
assertions: The email contains no headings or labels named Problem, Insight, Big Idea, Execution or Results
Total body length is roughly 90 words, not a five-section document
P and I are compressed, with the turn arriving by the second sentence
Written from equal standing, not as a request for a favor
Ends with one number and one specific ask
If the skill states which mode and resolution it chose, it does so in one line outside the email itself
